name: Hotfix: MP3 support for Sounds
author: Worse Code
description: Adds Windows Media Control playback for MP3 files to an installed Sounds plugin.

patches.find:
import ast
import os


def play_file(path, wait=False):
    import winsound

    flags = winsound.SND_FILENAME
    if not wait:
        flags |= winsound.SND_ASYNC
    winsound.PlaySound(path, flags)


def stop_playback():
    import winsound

    winsound.PlaySound(None, 0)

if not argument:
            raise ValueError("use: play file.wav")
patches.replace:
if not argument:
            raise ValueError("use: play file.wav or file.mp3")
